notes: "At lab meetings and other presentations, I noticed how readily people recognized AI-made slides. The tools had different styles, but the slides often tried to cover everything. I found the same problem in my own introduction: there was plenty of material, yet the point was hard to follow. The images here are earlier pages from my own introduction. These pages made me look again at the story I was trying to tell.\n\nAccount source: sources/story/USER-STORY.zh-CN.md. The explanation is based on the founder’s personal experience and design judgment."

designIntent.purpose: Connect the AI look recognized at lab meetings to the lack of focus in my own earlier introduction.
designIntent.requestedChange: Use the founder’s account to explain one experience or the design choice it prompted.
